rule: Pump-rate tables may be generated only when the dose ladder and final concentration are explicitly verified from an authoritative pediatric guideline, official product information, or a recognized pediatric pharmacology source. A Hospital da Horta local protocol is not required.

drugs.clinical_position: ERC/RCUK 2025 first-line vasopressor by shock phenotype; SSC 2026 does not prefer norepinephrine over epinephrine universally in pediatric septic shock
drugs.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: noradrenaline 0.02-2 mcg/kg/min; 0.3 mg/kg in 50 mL gives 1 mL/h = 0.1 mcg/kg/min

drugs.clinical_position: ERC/RCUK 2025 first-line inotrope by shock phenotype; AHA/AAP 2025 and SSC 2026 support epinephrine as an initial vasoactive option in pediatric septic shock
drugs.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: adrenaline 0.05-1.5 mcg/kg/min; 0.3 mg/kg in 50 mL gives 1 mL/h = 0.1 mcg/kg/min

drugs.clinical_position: AHA/AAP 2025: alternative initial vasoactive infusion when epinephrine/norepinephrine unavailable; not preferred first-line in current pediatric septic shock
drugs.source: Malaysia Ministry of Health Paediatric Protocols 5th ed 2025: dopamine 5-20 mcg/kg/min; for <30 kg, 30 mg/kg in 50 mL gives 1 mL/h = 10 mcg/kg/min
restrictions: source concentration formula explicitly stated for children <30 kg in the cited protocol

drugs.clinical_position: AHA/AAP 2025: may be reasonable for pediatric cardiogenic shock; product SmPC provides pediatric posology
drugs.source: Dobutamine SmPC: pediatric initial 5 mcg/kg/min, titrate 2-20 mcg/kg/min; example infusion solution 0.5 mg/mL

drugs.clinical_position: ERC/RCUK 2025 first-line inodilator by phenotype; SmPC provides pediatric infusion range
drugs.source: Milrinone SmPC: pediatric infusion 0.25-0.75 mcg/kg/min; published infusion solution 200 mcg/mL
restrictions: SmPC advises against pediatric use in renal impairment because data are lacking

drugs.clinical_position: PICU sedation: SCCM ICU Liberation/PANDEM supports protocolized sedation; SmPC provides pediatric ICU dose
drugs.source: Midazolam SmPC updated 2025: >6 months maintenance 0.06-0.12 mg/kg/h; concentrations >1 mg/mL not recommended in children <15 kg, so 1 mg/mL is a source-supported calculation concentration

drugs.clinical_position: SCCM pediatric ICU Liberation: opioid first-line for pain; usual continuous dose 0.5-5 mcg/kg/h
drugs.source: SCCM ICU Liberation pediatric usual dose 0.5-5 mcg/kg/h + fentanyl SmPC 50 mcg/mL, IV bolus/infusion in children
restrictions: continuous PICU use requires airway/respiratory monitoring and specialist titration

drugs.clinical_position: PANDEM/SCCM supports alpha2-agonists and pediatric dexmedetomidine use; current European SmPC states pediatric safety/efficacy not established and gives no pediatric posology
drugs.source: SCCM pediatric ICU Liberation usual dose 0.2-2 mcg/kg/h + European SmPC source concentration 4 mcg/mL; pediatric posology is not licensed in that SmPC
restrictions: guideline-supported pediatric use conflicts with European product label lack of pediatric posology; treat as off-label/product-jurisdiction dependent

drugs.clinical_position: Analgesic continuous infusion for severe pain/major trauma/burns/mucositis under pediatric pain/ICU/anesthesia supervision; this is not a generic PICU sedation ladder
drugs.source: Royal Children's Hospital Ketamine Infusion current online: 100-200 mcg/kg/h usual start, range 0-400 mcg/kg/h; standard concentrations 1 mg/mL (0-10 kg), 2 mg/mL (10-40 kg), 4 mg/mL (>=40 kg/fluid restricted)
restrictions: analgesia/pain-service or ICU/anesthesia supervised use; not a universal sedation regimen

drugs.clinical_position: PANDEM 2022 suggests short-term (<48 h) continuous propofol <4 mg/kg/h may be useful; some European SmPCs prohibit ICU sedation in patients <=16 years
drugs.source: PANDEM 2022: <4 mg/kg/h and <48 h may be a safe alternative; European SmPC/product restrictions may prohibit pediatric ICU sedation
restrictions: guideline/product-label conflict; do not auto-generate as routine PICU sedation without jurisdiction/product review
